name: provider-alert-debounce
title: provider 告警去抖与 outbox 合并投递
description: provider 告警恢复去抖（5 分钟静默窗口）+ outbox 同事故同 transition 合并 + 每轮最多投递 10 张
creator: linshu

module_impact.reason: Only backend/src/features/alerting delivery worker and generation/provider-alerts observer internals change; no verified module doc under .trellis/spec covers alerting, and no module-level contract, route, table or config changes.

mobile_performance.reason: No Android/iOS pages or public endpoints change. The observer adds an in-memory timestamp comparison on the generation response path without new IO; delivery runs in the separate payment-alert-monitor service. No mobile P95 samples are invented.

scope: AlertDeliveryWorker outbox coalescing and per-round batch delivery in payment-alert-monitor
integration_points: Reuse payment.alert_monitor.delivery_failed and runObservedJob round in scripts/payment-alert-monitor.ts
failure_paths: Supersede UPDATE failure propagates to the existing delivery_failed catch and the round is marked partial; next round retries
Feishu retryable/permanent failures keep existing retry/abandon logic and end the batch early
Publish failure keeps existing 60s cooldown; debounce never delays firing
logging_integration.correlation: Delivery runs inside the existing runObservedJob payment_alert_monitor root context; provider alert logs keep the request ALS context
logging_integration.redaction: Only counts, notification keys, provider and alert class; card payloads, upstream bodies and keys are never logged
logging_integration.alerting: No new alert rules; existing generation provider rules keep severity, and notification remains gated by runtime config notifications_enabled
verification: vitest provider-alerts.test.ts and delivery-worker.test.ts including debounce and coalescing cases
Post-deploy: ops.alert_delivery_jobs superseded/succeeded distribution and Feishu group card count
